Container.Name: karakeep-dashboard
Container.Overview: A fast start page for your Karakeep bookmarks: every list on one page in a masonry grid, instant offline search, drag and drop between lists, and an installable PWA.[br][br]The container only serves static files (non-root nginx, no volumes). Your browser talks to Karakeep directly: open the WebUI, paste your Karakeep address and an API key from Karakeep - Settings - API Keys. The key is stored in your browser only.[br][br]Requires a running Karakeep instance.
Container.Requires: A running Karakeep instance and an API key (Karakeep - Settings - API Keys).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is served on.

Config.Name: Karakeep URL
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the setup screen. Must be the address your BROWSER uses to reach Karakeep, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3000 - not a Docker container name and not localhost.

Config.Name: Allow embedding from
Config.Description: Optional. Space-separated origins (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3001) or 'self' allowed to show the dashboard in an iframe, for Homepage, Homarr or Dashy. Empty: embedding is denied.
